consent.intro: Smart Speech Flow is an automatic real-time language translation service designed to support conversations between people who speak different languages. The service runs exclusively on a dedicated private server.
consent.howTo: To start recording, tap the microphone button. You will then have 20 seconds to speak your input. You can also end the recording earlier with another tap. Alternatively, you can use the text input instead.
consent.retention: By default, audio and transcription data are processed only during the active session and are not retained afterwards. Once the conversation ends, the data is discarded automatically. You can report issues or share ideas for improvement at any time using the in-app feedback function.
consent.optIn: If you would like to help us improve Smart Speech Flow, you have the option to allow your conversation data to be stored for up to 180 days. This data may be used solely for analysis and quality improvement purposes within the Smart Speech Flow project.
consent.checkbox: I agree to the storage of my conversation data for up to 180 days for the purpose of improving Smart Speech Flow.
